[[File:Nicolette.png|thumb|250px|Nicolette]] '''Nicolette''' (Japanese: '''シロミ''' ''Shiromi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG150|May's Egg-cellent Adventure]]''. She works at a [[Kanto]] [[Pokémon Day Care|breeding center]] with her parents, [[Christopher and Jeannie]], who raise [[Pokémon Egg]]s. Nicolette confronted {{ashfr|the group}} after {{an|May}} stepped onto the property and was consequently zapped by the guarding {{p|Voltorb}}. She quickly changed her manner after recognizing May as the winner of the [[Saffron City]] {{pkmn|Contest}}. She revealed that she had dreams of becoming a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] like May, but didn't think she could handle it. Her confidence took a hit after her {{p|Vileplume}} was defeated by [[May's Munchlax]]. who learned {{m|Focus Punch}} during the match. May later caught up with Nicolette to talk things over while the pair polished Eggs together. When {{TRT}} attacked the farm with their [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]], Nicolette sent out her Vileplume to prevent the trio from leaving with the Eggs. After Team Rocket was defeated, she and the others watched as the glowing Egg hatched into a {{p|Vulpix}}. She also gave an {{TP|May|Egg|Eevee}} to May as a show of thanks for helping her out. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Nicolette's known Pokémon: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Nicolette |pkmn=Vileplume |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Nicolette Vileplume.png |epnum=AG150 |epname=May's Egg-Cellent Adventure |desc=Nicolette called out her {{p|Vileplume}} to challenge {{an|May}} and her {{TP|May|Munchlax}} to a battle. Vileplume initially had the upper hand as it managed to confuse and paralyze Munchlax. However, Munchlax unexpectedly learned to use {{m|Focus Punch}} before defeating Vileplume with a Solar Beam. Vileplume was later used to stop {{TRT}} when they tried to steal the {{pkmn|Egg}}s. Vileplume's known moves are {{m|Petal Dance}}, {{m|Solar Beam}}, {{m|Stun Spore}}, and {{m|Bullet Seed}}.}} ===Given away=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=May |pkmn=Egg |main=May's Eevee |type1=Unknown |img=May Eevee Egg.png |epnum=AG150 |epname=May's Egg-cellent Adventure |desc=Nicolette rewarded {{an|May}} with this Egg as a reward for helping her. In ''[[AG157|Time Warp Heals All Wounds]]'', it hatched into an {{TP|May|Eevee|Glaceon}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=菊地美香 ''Mika Kikuchi'' |en=[[Emlyn McFarland|Emlyn Morinelli]] |fr_eu=Coralie Vanderlinden |it=Tosawi Piovani |pt_br=Samira Fernandes |es_la=Karla Falcón |es_eu=Marta Sainz}} ==Trivia== * Nicolette's Japanese name, ''Shiromi'', can be taken to mean "egg white" (白身 ''shiromi''). ** Likewise, [[Christopher and Jeannie|her parents']] Japanese names are also egg-based.
